cells.gaps: The ministry of digital transformation, created in 2021, is described in August 2025 as the institutional lever for the agenda (MRT-050), and the state digital agency presented its role in implementing the state's digital strategy in October 2026 (MRT-049); funding is donor-backed with no domestic budget line. No report against the agenda's own targets is held, only claims of activity. The agenda was under evaluation and update in August 2025 (MRT-051); its successor, Agenda National de la Transformation Numerique 2030, was opened for preparation on 4 Dec 2025 (a consultant was contracted in July 2025) and has no adoption or text.
cells.note: Instrument: Agenda national de transformation numerique 2022-2025, adopted in 2022 with a public, costed text, but its period ended in 2025 and the successor is in preparation, so stage 2 and lapsed. Stage 3 needs a period not ended.
